}","note":"Later validation/exponentiation uses the Montgomery engine with the attacker-influenced group parameters."},{"step":6,"file":"src/lib/math/numbertheory/monty_exp.cpp","function":"Montgomery_Exponentiator::execute","line":25,"var":"m_monty,m_e","code":"return monty_execute(*m_monty, m_e);","note":"Exponentiation dispatches into Montgomery arithmetic on the cached modulus size."},{"step":7,"file":"src/lib/math/numbertheory/monty.cpp","function":"Montgomery_Params::mul","line":52,"var":"output_size","code":"const size_t output_size = 2*m_p_words + 2;","note":"The Montgomery helpers assume the destination BigInt has 2*p_words+2 words available."},{"step":8,"file":"src/lib/math/numbertheory/monty.cpp","function":"Montgomery_Params::mul","line":55,"var":"z","code":"BigInt z(BigInt::Positive, output_size);","note":"The destination is allocated using the rounded-up word count, which is the critical size assumption."},{"step":9,"file":"src/lib/math/mp/mp_monty.cpp","function":"bigint_monty_redc","line":22,"var":"z/ws","code":"const size_t z_size = 2*(p_size+1);","note":"The reduction routine writes as if z is exactly 2*p_words+2 words long and uses that bound for indexed stores."},{"step":10,"file":"src/lib/math/mp/mp_monty.cpp","function":"bigint_monty_redc","line":34,"var":"z_i[j]","code":"for(size_t j = p_size + 1; j < z_size - i; ++j) { z_i[j] += carry; ... }","note":"If the earlier allocation is too small for the true word count, these indexed writes run past the end of z and trigger the overflow."}]
